text: Harbour City empezó fuerte y se puso 2-0 con goles de Elias Okafor y Marek Barros, quien fue la estrella del partido con 1 gol, 2 asistencias y 5 pases clave[#905][#975]. Se abrieron espacios gracias a un juego paciente con muchos pases. Sin embargo, Seabrook Town no se rindió: después de la expulsión de Joon Whitfield para Harbour City, ajustaron el estilo para presionar más y jugar más directo, lo que les ayudó a empatar y luego ganar con 4 goles, incluidos dos de Kian Romano en los últimos minutos[#871][#1361][#1882]. Seabrook tuvo más tiros y mejores oportunidades, marcando 4 goles con un estilo rápido y amplio, mientras que Harbour City falló en mantener su ventaja pese a su buen inicio[#1104][#1882]. Fue un partido emocionante con un gran regreso de Seabrook Town al final.

trace.output: Brief: full-match recap for fan audience in es

- Seabrook Town scored 4 goals despite harbour City having an expected goals (xG) of 1.82 vs 3.87 for Seabrook Town, showing higher shot volume and quality from Seabrook Town [#1104, #1882].
- Marek Barros (Harbour City) was named player of the match with 1 goal, 2 assists, 5 key passes, and a rating of 10.0, making a decisive impact despite his team losing [#975].
- Harbour City started strong leading 2-0 with goals at 45' and 47', but Seabrook Town fought back starting at 53' and scored 4 goals including two late goals at 90+2' and 90+3' by Kian Romano [#905, #975, #1104, #1882, #1906].
- A red card was issued to Joon Whitfield at 43', potentially influencing the game dynamics before Harbour City's first goal [#871].
- Seabrook Town increased press intensity and directness at 65', shifting momentum towards their 4-goal comeback [#1361].

- Harbour City scored their opening goal after a patient build-up involving 17 passes over nearly a minute, starting from open play and culminating in a high-quality chance finished by Elias Okafor. This reflects their 4-2-3-1 formation and patient short passing style, focusing on retention and carefully crafted attacks [#904, #905].
- Marek Barros’s goal at 47' originated from a corner, with a quick developed cross, showing Harbour City’s effectiveness on set pieces within their structured formation [#973, #975].
- Seabrook Town’s first goal came immediately after regaining possession with no passing buildup, scoring quickly in open play, indicative of their more direct and pressing approach, exploiting turnovers efficiently within their 3-4-3 wide and crossing-oriented style [#1103, #1104].
- After falling behind, Seabrook Town’s coach adjusted tactics at 65', pressing higher and playing more direct, which led to increased field tilt and regained control, reflected in their next goals coming from quick regains and short passing sequences starting from turnovers, fitting their formation’s emphasis on wide player support and forward runs [#1361, #1447, #1448].
- The late pair of goals by Kian Romano came from fast counter-attacks and quick, short passing moves starting immediately after ball recovery, underlining Seabrook's capability to exploit high pressing and unsettled defense late in the game, consistent with the 3-4-3 setup and wide, crossing style [#1881, #1882, #1905, #1906].
